title: GroundTruth
description: One laser-measured real room, plus the captures taken of it (implementation-plan.md 3.10). This is the yardstick every reconstruction experiment is scored against, so it is measured by hand and checked into git. Millimetres throughout, matching 2.4.

room_id.description: Stable id, also the filename stem. Used to join a capture to its truth.

room_type.description: 3.10 asks for a spread: living rooms, bedrooms, an office, a kitchen/dining area, an open-plan space, a cluttered room and a sparse white-walled one.

traits.description: Why this room is in the set. The dataset is only useful if it covers the hard cases on purpose.

instrument.description: How this room was measured: a laser measure's model for Tier B, or the dataset and scene for Tier A. A systematic instrument error is worth being able to trace later.

source.description: Where this ground truth came from (3.10). Tier A is derived from a public dataset's laser scan by an adapter; Tier B is measured by hand in one of our own rooms. The distinction decides which experiments a room can settle: E2, E3 and E8 are only decided on Tier B.

derived_by.description: The adapter that produced this file, so it can be regenerated.

floor_polygon_mm.description: Optional but strongly wanted: without it E4 (polygon IoU) cannot be scored for this room. Derive it from the measured wall lengths and the hand-drawn plan. Same conventions as RoomModel: CCW [x, z], centroid at the origin.

walls.description: Every wall, measured. Ids run clockwise or anticlockwise consistently from the room's main door.

openings.description: Every door and window: width, height, sill, and the wall it is on with its offset from that wall's start.

furniture.description: Three pieces per room, per 3.10. Scores E6 footprint error.

floor_plan_photo.description: Path, relative to eval/, of the hand-drawn plan photo. Not tracked in git (it is under eval/captures/), but the path is recorded so a room can be checked by eye later.

captures.description: Three per room (3.10): two phones, and one deliberately sloppy run that feeds E8.

style.description: `sloppy` is the E8 case: faster pans, portrait. At least one per room.

duration_s.description: 3.2 caps a product capture at 180 s. Tier A dataset captures predate that rule, so the upper bound is looser here than the product's.

file.description: Path relative to eval/. The video itself is gitignored.
